# Trigger for: Morocco26 Agent Society V2 current-vintage 2026 population V2
#
# Bump the request line below and push to launch the build. Same idiom as
# .github/asv2-rich-populations-trigger.txt.
#
# The build no longer needs an uploaded artifact: it reads the committed
# named input and refuses any other bytes.
#
#   named input   morocco26/data/goal100/agent_society_v2/named_input_current_vintage_2026-08-22.json
#   sha256        9a4e3c121e01363354c88dd5582e392a26decf54316836fb80d5f96975b0b706
#   lineage       morocco26/data/goal100/agent_society_v2/NAMED_INPUT_2026_LINEAGE_V1.json
#   geometry      morocco26/data/goal100/geometry_2026_certificate.json (PASS, 92 rows)
#   labour        morocco26/data/goal100/agent_society_v2/LABOUR_CONTEXT_2026_Q2_HCP.json (HCP EMO2026 Q2)
#
# Expected result: 92/92 territories, zero failures, certificate PASS, geometry
# lineage PASS, no political memory. That output is what freeze revision 3 will
# record, and what R2 will bridge before R3 runs.

# Verified independently on 2026-08-24, from a client outside CI: all three
# source files download complete and hash exactly as recorded.
#
#   rgph_individual.dta  200,532,997 bytes  62dbbfc6...  match
#   rgph_household.dta    39,442,553 bytes  0c630cfa...  match
#   encdm_household.sav   33,254,643 bytes  6a3d6bbb...  match
#
# So HCP did not republish: runs 32742167166 and 32742873701 died on a truncated
# transfer inside CI, which neither the bare `wait` nor a 1 MB size floor could
# detect. p3_fetch_microdata.py now compares received bytes to Content-Length per
# file and retries a short read.

request: 2026-08-24 rebuild with per-file completeness verification
